quizzes.title: General Knowledge & Science Master Quiz
quizzes.description: Imported via Python script — Test your core knowledge of General Science and World Geography!

questions.questionText: Which planet in our solar system is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet because of iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.questionText: What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?
questions.explanation: Diamond is carbon arranged in a crystal lattice structure and is the hardest natural material.

questions.questionText: Which element has the chemical symbol 'O'?
questions.explanation: Oxygen has the atomic number 8 and the symbol O.
